mapper.select: SELECT TASK_STATUS_ID, STATUS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, active(IS_ACTIVE) as IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, EDITOR_USER_ID, active(IS_FINAL) as IS_FINAL FROM task_statuses
mapper.update:
UPDATE task_statuses
status_name=#{statusName},
description=#{description},
is_active=#{isActive},
is_final=#{isFinal},
EDITOR_USER_ID = #{userId}, updated_at = SYSDATE
WHERE task_status_id = #{taskStatusId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_statuses( TASK_STATUS_ID, STATUS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE, IS_FINAL, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES( task_status_seq.NEXTVAL, #{statusName}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{isFinal}, SYSDATE, #{userId} )
